topic: Someone discovers a hidden room in their new house
text: I suppose it’s only fitting that this house, which seemed so perfect at first glance, would still hold secrets. The walls, whispering their silent tales, have finally spoken. A hidden room, tucked away like a forgotten promise. I can’t help but wonder what stories it cradles, what shadows it has witnessed. It’s a bit much, really, finding something so unexpected after thinking I knew every inch of this place. Now, I’m compelled to peel back another layer, to see what else lies beneath the surface. The old house, it seems, isn’t done with me yet.
